note: homelab-download job (wget/aria2c in a systemd unit); exit 143 = stopped by SIGTERM (Ryan or the panel's Stop), usually not a fault.

homelab-download job that failed on its own (an exit status other than 143, so not a Stop): the context usually says why. A 404 / resource-not-found means the link is dead or expired and needs re-linking; a retry will not help.
Flint 3 Wi-Fi radio interface; brief down/up happens on channel or config changes and radio restarts. It only matters if it repeats many times a day.
Proxmox timer that sends SMART data to Scrutiny on Unraid. It fails when Scrutiny is unreachable.
Kernel OOM kill. The cgroup or unit named in the context is the one that hit its limit.
DNS probe of the Orange Pi Pi-hole replica (.10). It has gone off the network before (7 Nov); net-watchdog bounces/reboots it.

Agent or benchmark job that Ryan or an agent started on purpose with systemd-run (bench-* = GPU benchmarks, agy-* = Antigravity runs, pi-queue = pi's job queue). Each writes its own report or log, so a failure here is already reported there: verdict ignore, unless the same unit fails on several nights.
